(d) Since you have a love for modern dance, I’d suggest checking out any contemporary dance companies or experimental performance art showcases happening that weekend—especially those that blend storytelling with movement. You might also find smaller shows at independent theaters or cultural centers that feature emerging choreographers pushing creative boundaries. Pairing one of these with a post-show conversation or artist Q&A can make for a really inspiring evening.
